problem: The tanker's density figure, in his hand the same day
action: Daytime beside the plain unmarked tanker. The dealer stands writing into an open slim register balanced on his forearm, pen in hand, his phone tucked under the same thumb. He is mid-entry and unhurried.
lighting: Bright clean daylight with the bulk of the tanker shading one side of frame, warm bounce off the concrete onto his face.
camera: Chest-up, he is centre-left of the vertical frame with the tanker flank soft behind him on the right. Sharp on his hands and face. 35mm.
detail: The register page carries faint ruling only — NO legible writing, NO numbers, NO words. The tanker is COMPLETELY UNMARKED: no logo, no livery, no lettering, no number plate. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: The figure arrives; he writes it down; the job is closed the day it happened.
motion: His pen hand completes a short movement across the page. A slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: टैंकर की डेंसिटी उसी दिन आपके हाथ में।
